verdict.rationale: Extend documents deployable, versioned Workflows ([extend-docs-19], [extend-docs-43]) that run against uploaded files ([extend-docs-32]). Every processing endpoint supports asynchronous mode ([extend-docs-37], [extend-docs-13]), production webhooks deliver results ([extend-docs-12], [extend-docs-38]), and confidence scores let high-confidence values be trusted automatically while the rest go to human review ([extend-docs-34]). Together these support document pipelines that run without supervision once a run is started. However, most of this evidence is page titles, and nothing shows workflows starting on their own. Missing for 10: documented triggers or scheduling (e.g. auto-run on file arrival or on a cron), detail on configuring always-on background automations, and independent hands-on corroboration.
